title: MonitorLoadDTO
description: MonitorLoadDTO schema from Monitor Plan Management OpenAPI Specification

maximumLoadValue.description: Maximum hourly gross load associated with the unit, stack, or pipe at full capacity.

maximumLoadUnitsOfMeasureCode.description: Code used to identify the units of measure for maximum load value

lowerOperationBoundary.description: Lower boundary of range of operation.

upperOperationBoundary.description: Upper boundary of range of operation.

normalLevelCode.description: Code used to identify the normal load or operating level.

secondLevelCode.description: Code used to identify the second most frequently used load or operating level.

secondNormalIndicator.description: Used to indicate the reporting of an additional normal load or a second operating level.

loadAnalysisDate.description: The date in which load analysis was performed.  This date only applies to CEM and Appendix D locations.

beginDate.description: Date on which information became effective or activity started.

beginHour.description: Hour in which information became effective.

endDate.description: Last date in which information was effective.  This date will be null for active records.

endHour.description: Last hour in which information was effective.  This value will be null for active records.

id.description: Unique identifier of a monitoring load record.

locationId.description: Unique identifier of a monitoring location record.

userId.description: User account or source of data that added or updated record.

addDate.description: Date and time in which record was added.

updateDate.description: Date and time in which record was last updated.

active.description: Flag for active monitor location record
